title: Loukoumades Tres Leches
description: A creative twist on traditional Mexican tres leches cake, incorporating the sweetness of Greek loukoumades. Fermented honey adds depth to this dessert.
instructions: Pierce the loukoumades with a fork to allow syrup to penetrate.
In a large saucepan, combine honey, heavy cream, evaporated milk, and condensed milk.
Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is hot and the honey is dissolved.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract.
Place the loukoumades in a large baking dish and pour the tres leches mixture over them.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the loukoumades are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with powdered sugar and cinnamon.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
